skill.name: email-quality-auditor
skill.description: Use when the user asks to "audit an email program", "is this campaign safe to send", or run a pre-send go/no-go on their own exported email data; runs SEND EQS scoring with S1/S2/N1/D1 veto checks and a SHIP/FIX/BLOCK gate, and emits a gated audit artifact. Not for building deliverability setup — use deliverability-qa; not for designing lifecycle flows — use email-sequence-designer. 邮件质量审计/EQS评分/发送前放行
skill.summary: Runs SEND email quality scoring and pre-send gate checks.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

content.value_statement: Email teams need a clear send decision before campaigns reach subscribers. This skill checks deliverability, consent, lifecycle, and claims evidence with SEND scoring.
actual_capabilities: Scores Sender, Engagement, Nurture, and Direct-response using SEND goal weights.
Checks S1, S2, N1, and D1 veto conditions before a send.
Computes EQS with floor rounding and applies cap rules.
Produces SHIP, FIX, or BLOCK send decisions.
Creates an auditor handoff for email audit memory records.
limitations: Requires user-provided exports for full-confidence scoring.
Does not build DNS authentication, flows, creative, or consent records.
Treats SEND score bands as provisional until more audits calibrate them.
Cannot verify missing external evidence without user input or enabled connectors.

use_cases.title: Approve a broadcast send
use_cases.description: Run a go/no-go check before a promotional campaign reaches a large segment.

use_cases.title: Audit lifecycle health
use_cases.description: Score welcome, cart, post-purchase, and win-back flows with one SEND framework.

use_cases.title: Reduce deliverability risk
use_cases.description: Check authentication, consent, unsubscribe, and claims evidence before scaling volume.

prompt_templates.title: Basic pre-send check
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this campaign before I send it. Goal: promotional. I can provide the ESP export, DMARC report, inbox test, and consent record.

prompt_templates.title: Newsletter program audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether this newsletter program should ship. Goal: retention. Review deliverability, cadence, unsubscribe setup, engagement, and consent evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Lifecycle flow gate
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a SEND audit for this lifecycle flow. Use the flow export, suppression history, revenue export, and claims evidence to decide SHIP, FIX, or BLOCK.

prompt_templates.title: Cold outbound launch audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a full SEND audit for a cold outbound launch. Check authentication, lawful basis, suppression enforcement, inbox placement, claims, and response evidence.

output_examples.input: Promotional broadcast with passing authentication, complete consent records, and a missing one-click unsubscribe header.
output_examples.output: FIX: Authentication and consent are acceptable, but the unsubscribe path must be corrected before launch. Re-audit after the ESP header is verified.

output_examples.input: Cold outbound campaign using a purchased list and claims without approved support.
output_examples.output: BLOCK: Do not send. Consent cannot be verified, and the claims need substantiation before any acquisition campaign proceeds.

output_examples.input: Retention newsletter with aligned DMARC, clean suppression records, healthy engagement, and verified revenue data.
output_examples.output: SHIP: The program clears the veto checks and has enough supporting evidence for the selected retention goal.

best_practices: Provide ESP, DMARC, inbox placement, consent, and revenue exports together.
Confirm the goal column before interpreting the score.
Fix veto failures with the owning setup or registry skill, then re-audit.
anti_patterns: Treating open rate as the only quality signal.
Passing missing consent or DMARC evidence by default.
Sending after a BLOCK verdict without correcting the failed evidence.

faq.question: What does this skill audit?
faq.answer: It audits email send quality across deliverability, engagement, lifecycle readiness, and direct-response evidence.

faq.question: Can it send emails for me?
faq.answer: No. It provides an audit verdict and handoff. It does not execute a campaign send.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide ESP exports, DMARC reports, inbox placement results, consent records, and revenue or conversion exports.

faq.question: What do SHIP, FIX, and BLOCK mean?
faq.answer: SHIP means proceed, FIX means correct issues first, and BLOCK means a red-line problem stops the send.

faq.question: Does it replace deliverability setup work?
faq.answer: No. It judges readiness. Use setup or registry skills to repair DNS, consent, lifecycle, or claims problems.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, or Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible skill hosts.
